tenders.title: Tender For Request for Quotation for Implementation of an Integrated Enterprise GIS and 3D Digital Twin Platform for Geo-Analytics Property Tax Enhancement Asset
tenders.scope_summary: Request for Quotation (RFQ) for an integrated Enterprise GIS and 3D Digital Twin Platform for geo-analytics, property tax enhancement, and asset management. The platform aims to leverage advanced geospatial technologies for urban planning and administration.
key_points: Implementation of an integrated Enterprise GIS platform.
Development of a 3D Digital Twin for geo-analytics and property tax.
The tender was published on May 8, 2026.

tenders.title: GIS BASED INTEGRATED AIRPORT ASSET MANAGEMENT SYSTEM at Cochin International Airport (including 6 years AMC)
tenders.scope_summary: Implementation of an integrated GIS-based asset management platform for Cochin International Airport, including comprehensive data acquisition, processing, modeling, system integration, application development, deployment, training, and long-term support (6 years AMC).
key_points: Creation of high-quality basemaps and integration with existing systems.
Capture and integration of infrastructure and utility changes.
Advanced 3D visualization of indoor and outdoor airport infrastructure creating a Digital Twin.
Provision of GIS-enabled asset management and operational solutions, including mobile inspection applications, workflow management, and dashboards.
Bidder/OEM must have experience supplying Enterprise GIS software for 3 projects, including at least one in a Port and an Airport in India in the last 3 financial years.
Net Worth of the Bidder should be positive for the last 3 financial years (FY 2022-23, 2023-24 & 2024-25).

tenders.title: IoT Based Energy Monitoring and Asset Management
tenders.tendering_authority: Artificial Limbs Manufacturing Corporation Of India (ALIMCO), Ministry Of Social Justice And Empowerment
tenders.scope_summary: Tender for IoT-based energy monitoring and asset management, including supply, installation, testing, and commissioning of various energy monitoring devices, digital circuit breaker controllers, ground monitoring devices, and integration of a water automation pump system with an IIoT 4.0 platform.
key_points: Supply of High Profile Multifunction Energy Meters (LED Display) with Wi-Fi communication.
Supply of Multifunction Energy Monitoring Devices (without display) with Wi-Fi communication.
Supply of Multifunction Energy Meters with RS485 Communication.
Supply of Time Switches with integrated load disconnector and energy monitoring, and Wi-Fi communication.
Integration of Water Automation Pump System with IIoT 4.0 Platform.
Supply of Industrial IoT Communication Gateway with RS485 Device Connectivity and WiFi Communication.
